tune: tū, tuī — you (sg.) + -ne (interrog. enclitic): tūne, is it you…?
turbati: turbō, -āre, -āvī, -ātum — to disturb, throw into confusion (perf. pass. part., m. nom. pl., with animī)
turbidus: turbidus, -a, -um — stormy, wild, confused, turbulent (m. nom. sg.)
turnum: Turnus, -ī (m.) — Turnus, king of the Rutulians, rival of Aeneas for Lavinia (acc. sg.)
turnus: Turnus, -ī (m.) — Turnus, young king of the Rutulians, suitor of Lavinia (nom. sg.)
tuta: tūtus, -a, -um — safe, sheltered (n. nom./acc. pl.; f. nom./abl. sg.)
tuum: tuus, -a, -um — your, yours (sg.) (m. acc. sg.; n. nom./acc. sg.)
una: ūnus, -a, -um — one, a single (f. abl./nom. sg.); ūnā (adv.), together · also ūnā, adv., once (satis ūnā superque, enough once and more)
urgente: urgeō, -ēre, ursī — to press hard, beset, bear down on (pres. part., m./f./n. abl. sg.)
ut: ut (conj.) — + subj. so that, in order that; + indic. as, when, how · also + subj., how (indirect exclamation: cernis ut insultent) · also + subj., oh that (wish: ut … ludar)
utque: ut (conj.) — that, so that, as, when (+ -que 'and')
valet: valeō, -ēre, -uī — to be strong, have power, be able (3rd sg. pres.)
vana: vānus, -a, -um — empty, false, idle (f. abl. sg.; f. nom. sg.; n. nom./acc. pl.)
veni: veniō, -īre, vēnī, ventum — to come, arrive (1st sg. perf.) · also sg. imper., come!
verus: vērus, -a, -um — true, real, genuine (m. nom. sg.)
videre: videō, -ēre, vīdī, vīsum — to see, behold (pres. inf.) · also 3rd pl. perf. (= vīdērunt)
vidit: videō, -ēre, vīdī, vīsum — to see, behold (3rd sg. perf.)
voces: vōx, vōcis (f.) — voice, word, utterance (acc. pl.; also nom. pl.)
volscorum: Volscī, -ōrum (m. pl.) — the Volscians, a people of Latium (gen. pl.)
volucrem: volucris, -is — winged; (f.) bird (adj./noun, f. acc. sg.)
volvitur: volvō, volvere, volvī, volūtum — to roll, tumble (3rd sg. pres. pass.)
vulnere: vulnus, -eris (n.) — wound, blow (abl. sg.; also dat. sg.)
